name: jovial-lsp-client
description: VS Code client for the Jovial OCaml LSP server

jovial.server.path.description: Path to Jovial LSP server executable. Leave empty to use bundled server from the VSIX.

jovial.server.preferBundled.description: Prefer bundled server binaries over jovial.server.path when bundled binaries are available.

jovial.server.args.description: Extra command-line args passed to the server.

jovial.trace.description: Trace LSP traffic in the client output channel.

jovial.lsif.fastPath.description: Enable LSIF cache as a fallback for definition/implementation/references/hover when the server has no result yet.

jovial.workspaceDiagnostics.mode.description: Background diagnostics for unopened files: off, errors-only, or all diagnostics.

jovial.performance.priorityMode.description: Choose whether the server prioritizes hover/goto/navigation before diagnostics.

jovial.performance.largeFileThresholdByt.description: File size where the server switches from small-file foreground parsing to normal staged indexing.

jovial.performance.hugeFileThresholdByte.description: File size above which the server enters huge-file mode and uses the 10s open-file readiness exception.

jovial.performance.fullSemanticTokensMax.description: Maximum file size for full semantic-token responses before the server uses capped lexical/range fallbacks.

jovial.performance.fullParseMaxBytes.description: Maximum file size the server will fully parse by default; the default keeps files up to 15 MB parse-eligible.

jovial.performance.enableHugeFileFullPar.description: Allow full parsing for huge files when the full-parse byte limit also permits it.

jovial.performance.backgroundParseWorker.description: Number of background parse workers used for staged indexing.

jovial.implementation.dialect.description: Optional implementation dialect/profile name passed to the language server for target-specific conservative checks.

jovial.implementation.bitsInWord.description: Target word size in bits. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.bytesInWord.description: Target word size in bytes. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.floatPrecision.description: Default floating precision for unsized JOVIAL F types. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.fixedPrecision.description: Default fixed-point fraction precision for unsized JOVIAL A types. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.maxIntSize.description: Optional maximum integer size for the active implementation profile. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.maxBits.description: Optional maximum bit-string size for the active implementation profile. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.maxBytes.description: Optional maximum byte/string size for the active implementation profile. Leave null when unknown.

jovial.implementation.systemSubroutines.description: Machine-specific system subroutine names supplied by the active implementation profile. The server suppresses unresolved diagnostics and shows system-routine hover for these names.

enumDescriptions: Disable heavier passive work while keeping common editor help responsive.
Keep only the lightest passive editor help enabled.
Use jovial.features.custom.enabledFeatures to choose the passive features to enable.
jovial.features.profile.description: Passive LSP feature profile. Choose custom to pick individual passive features from jovial.features.custom.enabledFeatures.

enumDescriptions: Show CodeLens reference and impact counts.
Show procedure argument and type-detail inlay hints.
Format JOVIAL documents and ranges conservatively.

jovial.features.custom.enabledFeatures.description: Passive LSP features enabled when jovial.features.profile is custom.

jovial.features.overrides.diagnostics.deprecationMessage: Diagnostics are always enabled as core language support; use jovial.workspaceDiagnostics.mode to tune unopened-file diagnostics.
jovial.features.overrides.diagnostics.description: Legacy diagnostics override; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.diagnostics.deprecationMessage: Diagnostics are always enabled as core language support; use jovial.workspaceDiagnostics.mode to tune unopened-file diagnostics.
jovial.features.diagnostics.description: Legacy diagnostics override; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.definition.deprecationMessage: User-triggered navigation is always available; omit invoking it to avoid using it.
jovial.features.definition.description: Legacy setting; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.declaration.deprecationMessage: User-triggered navigation is always available; omit invoking it to avoid using it.
jovial.features.declaration.description: Legacy setting; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.typeDefinition.deprecationMessage: User-triggered navigation is always available; omit invoking it to avoid using it.
jovial.features.typeDefinition.description: Legacy setting; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.implementation.deprecationMessage: User-triggered navigation is always available; omit invoking it to avoid using it.
jovial.features.implementation.description: Legacy setting; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.references.deprecationMessage: User-triggered references are always available; omit invoking them to avoid using them.
jovial.features.references.description: Legacy setting; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.overrides.documentSymbol.description: Override document symbols for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.workspaceSymbo.description: Override workspace symbols for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.hover.description: Override hover for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.signatureHelp.description: Override signature help for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.rename.deprecationMessage: User-triggered rename is always available; omit invoking it to avoid using it.
jovial.features.rename.description: Legacy setting; ignored by the current server.

jovial.features.overrides.completion.description: Override completion for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.codeActions.description: Override code actions for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.codeLens.description: Override CodeLens for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.inlayHints.description: Override inlay hints for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.formatting.description: Override formatting for the selected feature profile.

jovial.features.overrides.semanticTokens.description: Override semantic tokens for the selected feature profile.

jovial.background.indexBudgetMs.description: Server idle background work budget in milliseconds per tick.

jovial.background.diagBatchSize.description: Maximum number of background diagnostic updates published per idle batch.

jovial.workspace.profileMode.description: Workspace sizing profile used by the server when choosing indexing and scheduling defaults.

jovial.workspace.rootModel.description: How the server chooses workspace roots for background indexing.

jovial.workspace.manualRootFiles.description: Manual root files used when jovial.workspace.rootModel is set to manual.

jovial.workspace.maxStartupFiles.description: Maximum number of Jovial source files discovered per workspace folder during startup indexing.

jovial.workspace.extraSourceFileExtensio.description: Additional JOVIAL source file extensions to scan and watch, for example .j for projects that use it.

jovial.workspace.extraAssemblyFileExtens.description: Additional assembly file extensions whose labels can satisfy JOVIAL procedure linkage, for example .s.

jovial.server.pressureSoftMb.description: Soft memory pressure threshold in MB for server background work.

jovial.server.pressureCriticalMb.description: Critical memory pressure threshold in MB for server background work.

jovial.autostart.description: Start the language server automatically when a Jovial file is opened.

scripts.compile: npm run check:src && npm run bundle
scripts.test:integration:pinned: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node out-test/test/run_integration_tests.js
scripts.test:e2e-perf: npm run build:server:e2e && npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node out-test/test/run_e2e_perf.js
scripts.test:e2e-perf:huge: npm run build:server:e2e && npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node out-test/test/run_e2e_perf.js --profile huge
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.package:vsix:dev: npm run build:server:host && npm run verify:runtime:host && npx @vscode/vsce package
scripts.package:vsix:host: npm run build:server:host && npm run verify:runtime:host && npx @vscode/vsce package
